title: Re-audit uses and transformations of the gastric NRRS study
plain_language_question: Which repair, biological adaptation, evidence extension, or structural reuse of the anchor can produce a beginner-executable manuscript?
biological_unit: Not applicable at the umbrella gate
decisive_evidence: A portfolio with explicit multi-axis change maps, independent assessments, and human-readable trade-offs
falsifier: Fewer than two scientifically coherent and feasible manuscript candidates survive the corrected G0 gates
learning_objective: Learn to distinguish correctness repair, scientific adaptation, evidence extension, and genuine redirection
target_contribution: A reviewed candidate portfolio rather than an automatically selected construct-audit paper
claim_ceiling: No manuscript claim is authorized by this umbrella direction

title: Neural, vascular, or stromal: construct validity and transportability of the published NRRS
plain_language_question: Does the published eight-gene NRRS contain neural information beyond stage, purity, and major tissue-composition programs, and does its relative prognostic association reproduce independently?
biological_unit: Patient within bulk cohort; patient or tissue section for cellular and spatial checks
decisive_evidence: Independent survival estimates plus prespecified decomposition against neural, endothelial, fibroblast, epithelial, purity, MSI, and stage controls
falsifier: The score cannot be reconstructed without outcome tuning or no independent data can distinguish neural signal from composition
learning_objective: Learn frozen-score reconstruction, cohort lineage, survival validation, confounding decomposition, and cellular localization
target_contribution: A construct and reproducibility audit of one published score
claim_ceiling: Associational construct validity and relative prognostic replication only; no causal neural or treatment-predictive claim

title: Patient-level neural-stromal niche states across gastric cancer progression
plain_language_question: Are reproducible neural or Schwann-associated tissue niches present across gastric cancer progression, and which stromal or immune states accompany them?
biological_unit: Patient or tissue section with identifiable neural or Schwann units
decisive_evidence: A patient-level state definition reproduced in two independent spatial or histologic resources
falsifier: Two independent resources do not capture credible neural or Schwann units or required patient metadata
learning_objective: Learn neural-cell annotation, replicate-aware testing, spatial neighborhoods, and cross-platform validation
target_contribution: A biologically focused cross-scale map of neural-stromal niches
claim_ceiling: Associational spatial ecology and prognosis linkage only; no denervation or neural-causality claim

title: Reproducible external benchmark of published gastric prognostic signatures
plain_language_question: Which fully specified gastric prognostic formulas can be reconstructed and add information beyond clinical stage in independent cohorts?
biological_unit: Patient within an independent survival cohort
decisive_evidence: A formula-completeness flowchart and prespecified external discrimination and incremental-value comparison
falsifier: Fewer than three formulas are complete or cohorts lack comparable endpoints and clinical baselines
learning_objective: Learn formula extraction, harmonization, discrimination, calibration limits, and fair benchmarking
target_contribution: A transparent reproducibility benchmark of published gastric prognostic formulas
claim_ceiling: Relative discrimination, reproducibility, and incremental association only; no deployment claim

title: Approximate reconstruction of public-data NRRS figures
plain_language_question: Which published NRRS figures can be independently reconstructed from public data, and which discrepancies are irreducible?
biological_unit: Patient or cell from the documented public cohorts
decisive_evidence: A figure-by-figure reconstruction and discrepancy ledger with frozen assumptions and tested adapters
falsifier: The score or principal public-data contrasts cannot be reconstructed under any defensible prespecified preprocessing
learning_objective: Learn GEO and TCGA preprocessing, survival analysis, single-cell annotation, provenance, and figure verification
target_contribution: A training reconstruction and reusable adapters, not a stand-alone manuscript
claim_ceiling: Descriptive similarity and discrepancy reporting only

title: Does the published NRRS measure pathological perineural invasion in gastric cancer?
plain_language_question: When the published eight-gene NRRS is frozen and applied without outcome tuning, is it associated with pathologist-annotated perineural invasion beyond stage and tissue-composition controls?
biological_unit: Patient within a PNI-annotated bulk cohort, with cell or tissue section used only for orthogonal localization
decisive_evidence: A frozen NRRS association with pathological PNI in two independent gastric cohorts after stage, purity, CAF, endothelial, and inflammatory controls, supported or refuted by neural or glial localization
falsifier: The score cannot be reconstructed without outcome tuning, PNI labels are not independently available, or the apparent association is fully explained by stage or tissue composition
learning_objective: Learn frozen-score application, direct construct testing, clinical-label provenance, confounding controls, and orthogonal localization
target_contribution: Determine whether the published nerve label has an empirical connection to actual perineural invasion rather than generic prognosis or stroma
claim_ceiling: Associational interpretation of one published score; no causal neural, treatment-predictive, absolute-risk, or deployment claim

title: Spatial location of perineural-invasion-associated inflammation in gastric cancer
plain_language_question: Is the inflammatory program associated with pathological perineural invasion concentrated around credible neural or glial neighborhoods, or is it a general desmoplastic tumor program?
biological_unit: Spatial cell, spot, or region nested within tissue section and patient
decisive_evidence: A PNI-anchored program frozen in labeled bulk cohorts and enriched near bona fide neural or glial units in two independent spatial resources after CAF, myeloid, smooth-muscle, and tumor-region controls
falsifier: Two independent spatial resources lack credible neural or glial units, the PNI program cannot be measured, or proximity is fully explained by general desmoplasia
learning_objective: Learn pathology-anchored signature definition, rare neural-cell validation, multi-sample spatial neighborhoods, negative controls, and claim discipline
target_contribution: Connect a directly measured pathological event to a spatial neuroimmune ecology instead of inferring nerves from a survival-selected gene list
claim_ceiling: Human spatial association only; no proof of PNI causation, neural signaling, immunotherapy resistance, or treatment benefit

title: A new transcriptomic predictor of pathological perineural invasion in gastric cancer
plain_language_question: Can a new gene set derived from PNI-positive and PNI-negative tumors predict pathological PNI in an independent gastric cohort?
biological_unit: Patient within discovery and external validation cohorts
decisive_evidence: A locked classifier with external discrimination and calibration beyond stage and clinical baselines
falsifier: No independent PNI-labeled cohort, unstable features, or no incremental performance beyond simple clinical variables
learning_objective: Learn why a directly measured outcome does not automatically make another signature novel
target_contribution: A transparent PNI classifier only if it adds non-redundant information beyond published PNI inflammation, clinical, and imaging models
claim_ceiling: Prediction of pathological PNI only; no survival, treatment-benefit, or mechanistic neural claim

title: Multimodal pathology and transcriptomic mapping of perineural invasion in gastric cancer
plain_language_question: Can nerve-tumor geometry extracted from gastric whole-slide images, combined with a frozen PNI transcriptomic program, detect pathological PNI and explain recurrence risk better than either modality alone?
biological_unit: Patient as the primary unit, with slides and image regions nested within patient
decisive_evidence: Held-out patient-level PNI detection with external or temporal validation, interpretable nerve-tumor features, and independent transcriptomic or spatial concordance
falsifier: Usable PNI labels cannot be aligned to public slides, nerve regions require unavailable manual annotation, or multimodal performance does not exceed clinical or single-modality baselines
learning_objective: Learn WSI provenance, weak supervision, patient-level splitting, multimodal fusion, calibration, and biological interpretation
target_contribution: A higher-burden pathology-omics method linked to a concrete histological event rather than another bulk survival score
claim_ceiling: PNI detection and relative recurrence association only; no clinical deployment, treatment selection, or neural-causality claim
